text: There might be confusion because for new Olim (sometimes called new residents) there is a six month waiting period before they can get state health insurance through Bituach Leumi (this is to stop people making Aliyah for free medical treatment and then leaving). This doesn’t apply to most people who get A5 through the partner visa process, as they have already lived in Israel for 6 months. Your wife should be eligible for the general coverage as soon as she gets A5 (she just needs to sign up for Bituach Leumi). The waiting people for the extra plans is separate, but that only applies to the extra covers.
